scope: Terra high bounded escalation. Only nissay-theatre and line-cube-shibuya were reviewed; no other Tokyo COMPLEX, P2, or existing HOLD/MISMATCH target was reopened.

outcomes.firstPass: Terra visually read the official current PDF at original resolution. It independently transcribed the complete readable 1F central core (XA-XC and A-Q), confirmed the G.C. and 2F central structure, and found that the curved positions repeat printed numbers without a complete official row/area key.
outcomes.independentSecondPass: A separate reread of the official PDF and official theatre overview confirmed the same 1,334-seat total and the same blocker: 1扉 through 16扉 are door labels, not seat areas; no issuer-owned mapping connects every repeated curve position to a row/area identity.
outcomes.blocker: The repository model requires a lossless seat identity. Creating curved areas or row labels from geometry, or using the 1,334 total to resolve duplicates, would manufacture non-official identities. A seat-number key, ticketing seat specification, or equivalent issuer-owned coordinate-to-row/area source is required.

outcomes.firstPass: Terra reread the official three-page map and facility guide, confirming 1,956 total; 1F 1,180 including the four-seat multipurpose viewing room; 2F 424; and 3F 352.
outcomes.independentSecondPass: Independent official-source reread confirmed that the map separately states wheelchair space for 12 and use of 26 first-floor seats, while neither those 26 seat numbers nor individual multipurpose-room seat numbers are published.
outcomes.blocker: The official sources do not uniquely select between the 1,956 capacity including four unnumbered multipurpose seats, a derived numbered-only count, and a wheelchair-converted configuration. The 26 conversion targets are not identified. Arithmetic subtraction or guessed exclusions is prohibited.

summary.nextRecommended: Sol high bounded escalation for line-cube-shibuya only. Keep nissay-theatre on SOURCE/SCHEMA HOLD pending an issuer-owned curve seat-number key; keep kameari-lirio-hall and kioi-hall on their recorded post-renovation holds; do not start remaining Tokyo COMPLEX or P2 work.
